description: This file contains a servlet class named ImageUrlServlet that handles HTTP GET and POST requests to retrieve image URLs associated with content IDs in the OFBiz product image management module. It processes request paths, queries content entities and related data resources, and forwards requests to serve images or returns 404 errors if content is not found.

classes.name: ImageUrlServlet
classes.description: HttpServlet subclass responsible for processing image URL requests by extracting content IDs, querying entities, and forwarding to image view or returning error responses.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Delegates POST requests to the doGet method for processing.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests by parsing the request path, retrieving content and data resources from the database, and forwarding to an image view or sending a 404 error if content is not found.
